basic_info.description: This beautifully remodeled 3 bedroom, 3 bath Pacific Hts. residence offers a harmonious blend of classic charm and contemporary luxury in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Thoughtfully updated and elegantly appointed, this home is designed for both refined living and effortless entertaining.  A gracious entry foyer with a walk-in closet offers a welcoming transition into the home while providing seamless sightlines to the living room, dining room, and kitchen. At its heart, the large scale living room with a wood-burning fireplace is anchored by a wall of windows which frame captivating views of Mt. Tamalpais, SF Bay, and the Marin Headlands.Tailored for both everyday use and entertaining, the kitchen features a bespoke wet bar, radiant heat floors, premium finishes and a bounty of storage.The formal dining room opens onto a classic walk-out terrace, perfect for al fresco dining or morning coffee.The primary suite offers a serene retreat, complemented by a luxurious en suite bath with heated floors for spa-like comfort. A private guest suite with its own entrance provides ultimate flexibility ideal for hosting visitors. Elegant and understated with common access view roof, 97 WS and on-site property manager, enjoy the best of Pacific Hts living.
